appName.message: Refresh Em All: Tüm Sekmeleri Yenile
appName.description: Extension name: the product name, a colon, and a short descriptor. Keep "Refresh Em All" untranslated; translate the descriptor.

productName.description: Short product name for the popup header, the popup title and the toolbar tooltip. Keep untranslated.

htmlLang.description: BCP-47 language tag of THIS catalog. Resolved through Chrome's fallback chain so the popup's <html lang> always matches the language actually rendered, not the browser UI locale.

appDescription.message: Tüm sekmeleri her pencerede tek tıkla yenileyin. Dosyaları yeniden indirir, videoları kaldığı yerde tutabilir.
appDescription.description: Extension description shown as the Chrome Web Store summary and on chrome://extensions. At most 132 characters; lead with the words people search for.

actionRefreshAll.description: Label of the primary button that starts a refresh.

actionCancel.description: Label of the button that cancels a running refresh.

refreshExplanation.message: Yenileyebildiği sekmeleri yeniler ve Chrome'un daha önce kaydettiği kopyalar yerine dosyaları yeniden indirir. Site verileriniz değişmez.
refreshExplanation.description: Short explanation under the buttons describing what a refresh does.

readyTabCountOne.description: Ready screen: one tab open in one window, shown before the explanation.

readyTabCountOneWindow.description: Ready screen: several tabs open in one window.

readyTabCountWindows.description: Ready screen: tabs open across several windows.

retryFailedOne.description: Ready-screen button that reloads the one tab the last run could not reload.

retryFailedOther.description: Ready-screen button that reloads only the tabs the last run could not reload.

offlineWarning.message: İnternet bağlantınız yok. Şimdi yenilemek sekmeleri hata sayfasına çevirirdi; bağlantı gelince yenileyebilirsiniz.
offlineWarning.description: Ready screen while the computer has no network connection; the refresh buttons are disabled.

progressLabel.description: Accessible name of the progress bar.

statusRefreshingTabs.description: Initial status line before the first progress update arrives.

statusStarting.description: Status shown while the refresh request is being sent.

statusCancelling.description: Status shown while a cancellation request is being sent.

statusCancelFailed.description: Status shown when cancellation was rejected.

statusStartFailed.description: Status shown when the refresh could not be started.

statusProcessedInitial.description: Status shown right after the tab list is known and before any tab is processed.

statusCancelled.description: Final status after the user cancelled the refresh.

statusCompleteMixed.message: $TOTAL$ sekmeden $PROCESSED$ tanesi bitti: $REFRESHED$ yenilendi, $FAILED$ başarısız, $SKIPPED$ atlandı.
statusCompleteMixed.description: Final status when at least one tab failed.

statusCompleteSkipped.description: Final status when nothing failed but some tabs were skipped.

statusCompleteAll.description: Final status when Chrome accepted a reload for every tab.

statusInterrupted.description: Status shown when a refresh did not finish before the worker stopped.

errorInterruptedTitle.description: Error box heading for an interrupted refresh.

errorInterruptedDetail.description: Error box detail for an interrupted refresh.

errorStartTitle.description: Error box heading when the refresh never began.

errorFailedSummaryOne.description: Error box heading when exactly one tab failed.

errorFailedSummaryOther.description: Error box heading when two or more tabs failed. Turkish nouns stay singular after a number, so this matches the singular form.

errorNoTabDetails.message: Chrome belirli bir sekme için hata ayrıntısı vermedi.
errorNoTabDetails.description: Shown when a failure has no per-tab detail.

tabFallbackTitle.description: Placeholder name for a tab with no title.

historyUnknownDate.description: Shown when a history entry has an unreadable timestamp.

historyEntryCancelled.description: History line for a cancelled refresh.

historyEntryInterrupted.description: History line for a refresh that stopped because the extension's background worker stopped before it finished.

historyEntrySummary.description: History line for a completed refresh.

statsToggle.description: Button that expands the locally measured saved-file figures.

statsTodayLabel.description: Label for the cache statistics row for the current local date.

statsLastRunLabel.description: Label for the cache statistics row for the most recent refresh operation.

statsWeekLabel.description: Label for the cache statistics row for the current and previous six local dates.

statsMonthLabel.description: Label for the cache statistics row for the current and previous 29 local dates.

statsTotalLabel.description: Label for the all-time measured byte total.

statsRunLine.message: Yaklaşık $SIZE$, Chrome'un daha önce kaydettiği kopyalardan geliyordu ve yeniden indirildi; böylece sayfalar en yeni hallerini gösterir.
statsRunLine.description: Completion line showing files measured from copies Chrome saved earlier during the latest reload.

statsResetAction.description: Button that clears locally stored cache statistics.

statsNote.message: Her sayı bir tahmindir ve gerçek miktar genellikle daha yüksektir: bazı dosyalar boyutunu sayfaya bildirmez, ayrıca Chrome sayfanın yükleme kayıtlarından yalnız sınırlı sayıda tutar. Refresh Em All bunları tarayıcınızda ölçer ve hiçbir yere göndermez.
statsNote.description: Privacy and measurement-limit note below the cache statistics.

permissionGrantAction.description: Button that requests permission to read refreshed pages for best-effort media restoration and saved-file measurement.

permissionGrantExplain.message: Bu isteğe bağlı izin, Refresh Em All'un yenilediğiniz sayfaları okumasını sağlar. Uzantı bu izni videoları ve sesleri elinden geldiğince bıraktığınız yerde tutmak ve Chrome'un kayıtlı kopyalardan sunduğu dosyaları ölçmek için kullanır. İzin vermeseniz de sekmeler yenilenir.
permissionGrantExplain.description: Explanation shown beside the optional page-reading permission button.

statsAccessHint.message: Refresh Em All, yenilediğiniz sayfaları okuma iznine sahip olmadığı için yeni veri ölçülmüyor.
statsAccessHint.description: Notice shown above the saved-file figures while optional page-reading permission is missing.

settingsToggle.description: Button that expands the settings and privacy section.

privacyNotice.message: Bu uzantı gezinme verilerini, ölçümleri veya hata raporlarını hiçbir yere göndermez. Oynatmayı elinden geldiğince geri yüklemek için sayfanın kendi medya ayarlarını, sekme kapanınca temizlenen geçici depolamada kısa süre tutar; sayfa bu bilgiler silinene kadar onları okuyabilir.
privacyNotice.description: Privacy statement inside the settings section.

errorOperationInProgress.description: Reason returned when a refresh is requested while one is running.

errorNoTabs.description: Reason returned when the browser reported no tabs.

errorNoRefreshableTabs.message: Chrome, bu uzantının yenileyebileceği bir sekme döndürmedi
errorNoRefreshableTabs.description: Reason returned when every reported tab was unusable.

errorStartGeneric.description: Fallback reason when the refresh could not be started.

errorStartFailureTabTitle.description: Title of the synthetic failure entry recorded when a refresh never began.

errorReloadFailed.description: Fallback reason when Chrome rejected a reload without a message.

errorRefreshTimeout.description: Reason recorded when a single tab refresh exceeded its time budget.

errorTabRefreshFailed.description: Fallback per-tab failure reason sent to the popup.

heroReadySub.description: Line under the ready headline when there is no earlier reload.

heroReadySubIncognito.description: Line under the ready headline in an incognito window, where a run covers only incognito tabs.

heroLastRun.description: Line under the ready headline summarizing the latest reload. WHEN is a relative time from the browser, such as '2 hours ago'.

askTitle.description: Question shown on the first refresh before Chrome's permission dialog.

askAllow.description: First-run button: opens Chrome's permission dialog, then reloads.

askSkip.description: First-run button: reloads without asking for the permission.

runCountOf.description: Text after the large count of finished tabs while a reload runs.

footRunning.description: Note shown while a reload runs.

chipReloaded.description: Label after the number of reloaded tabs.

chipFailed.description: Label after the number of failed tabs.

chipSkipped.description: Label after the number of skipped tabs.

statusCompleteAllOne.description: Final status when the only tab in the run reloaded.

statusMilestone.description: Screen reader announcement at each quarter of a reload.

doneSubSkipped.description: Line under the completion title when browser pages were skipped.

doneSubUnsaved.description: Completion line when tabs with text the user typed were skipped so it was not lost.

actionBack.description: Accessible name of the back button in a sub view.

moreNavLabel.description: Accessible name of the list of secondary views.

historyTitle.description: Row and view title for the reload history.

historyEmpty.description: Shown when there is no reload history.

historyEntryReloaded.description: History row title for a finished reload.

historyEntryDetail.description: History row detail for a finished reload.

historyEntryStoppedDetail.description: History row detail for a cancelled reload.

historyEntryInterruptedDetail.description: History row detail for an interrupted reload.

settingsAccessTitle.description: Settings card title for the optional permission.

settingsAccessOn.description: Settings row summary when the permission is granted.

settingsAccessOff.description: Settings row summary when the permission is not granted.

pillOff.description: Small status label: permission not granted.

settingsStatsTitle.description: Settings card title for the statistics reset.

settingsStatsExplain.message: Yeniden İndirilen Dosyalar altındaki sayıları siler. Geçmiş kalır.

statsResetDone.description: Confirmation after Reset statistics, next to Undo.

actionUndo.description: Button that restores the statistics just reset.

statsApproxPrefix.description: Small qualifier shown before an estimated cache statistic value.

refreshThisTab.description: Secondary button that reloads only the active tab.

refreshThisTabHint.message: Dosyaları yeniden indirir, videolar kaldığı yerden sürer.
refreshThisTabHint.description: Short line under Refresh only this tab when page reading is allowed.

refreshThisTabHintNoAccess.description: Short line under Refresh only this tab when page reading is off, so videos cannot be kept in place.

thisTabUnavailable.message: Chrome bu sayfayı korur, buradan yenilenemez.
thisTabUnavailable.description: Reason shown when the active tab is a browser page an extension cannot reload.

thisTabLabel.description: Label above the site name while only the active tab reloads, and in history.

statusThisTab.description: Progress text while only the active tab reloads.

statusThisTabDone.description: Final status after only the active tab reloaded. SITE is a host name.

statusThisTabStopped.description: Final status after the user cancelled a single-tab reload. SITE is a host name.

statusThisTabStoppedSub.description: Line under the stopped single-tab status.

statusThisTabSkipped.description: Final status when the active tab closed or became a browser page before it reloaded. SITE is a host name.

askExplain.message: Videolar kaldığı yerden sürer, yeniden indirilen dosyalar ölçülür. Chrome ardından tüm sitelerdeki verileri okuma uyarısını gösterir; uzantı izni yalnız bunlar için kullanır, hiçbir şey göndermez. İzin vermeseniz de yenileme çalışır.
askExplain.description: Short explanation under the first-run question.

failedListLabel.description: Accessible name of the list of tabs that failed to reload.
